author: Devika Mathur
content: We are so pleased with the prompt service! We recently hired a ball pit from Dancing cubs for my toddler's birthday party. The booking process was super easy, staff we spoke to were very friendly, the ball pit arrived at the party venue well in time and was set up by the supplier themselves which made things so convenient for us, giving us time to focus on other aspects of the party. We got the D shaped ball pit which was actually quite big and also surprisingly deep. The kids absolutely loved it! At the end of the party, we packed up the balls and everything was collected by the team. The deposit of £50 was also promptly returned. All in all a great service and highly recommended!
